system.description:
Hanami Style: Sapping Fist · cast at S-Rank · no type

Twice per turn, when you deal [Unarmed Damage], you gain temporary hit points equal to it (they stack).

You also regain hit points equal to the [Unarmed Damage] dealt.

Monstrous Burst: your [Unarmed Damage] can be necrotic; each 5 or 6 on the die adds 1d6 (up to 4 times a turn).

Healers Touch: when you deal [Unarmed Damage], a willing creature within 10 feet gains temporary hit points equal to it.
